description: Bug regression: Host proactively messaged 'unit is ready for you to check in now' (9AM). Guest replied they'll arrive in ~1h + thanks. Auto-reply must NOT contradict by saying 4pm policy; must be warm 'You're welcome' style acknowledgment only. History + earlyUnitReadyOffered trace must prevent the 4pm restatement.
guestMessage: Ahh that’s perfect!! We will be arriving in about an hour! Thank you

Ahh that’s perfect!! We will be arriving in about an hour! Thank you

notes: Exact reproduction of the 9AM Taylor incident that caused contradiction. The prior host ready message must cause earlyUnitReadyOffered=true (via ConversationContextTool scan), the CRITICAL block in prompt, and judge to catch 4pm if it slips. Good reply: short warm 'You're welcome, Taylor! Perfect, see you in about an hour.' or equivalent — no policy, no greeting if recent host. Use natural name.
